trade_study_8mm.note: Trade study 1.24/1.02 differs: 8 mm face, its face-load factor and load definitions differ from this script.

Fby_cnc_b6_mm.note: machined housing / reamed pins, at b = 6, scaled x b/6

Fby_combine.note: F_beta_y = (b/6)*sqrt((dA_ip sin aw)^2 + (dA_op cos aw)^2): in-plane tilt moves the flank along the line of action by x sin(aw), out-of-plane by x cos(aw) [D geometry]; independent directions -> RSS. WC (linear sum) is a sensitivity row. JGMA 1102 / ISO/TR 10064-3 allow half as much out-of-plane as in-plane deviation because it loads the flank harder [S kggear.co.jp 6.3]

J_rotor_kgm2.note: small iron-core DC motor rotor 0.2-1.0 g*cm^2; 5e-8 used for design

SF_shock.note: rare event, no fracture (same rule as LC3)

SH_min.note: flank: slow, wear-limited polymer contact; metals static

a_max_mm.note: compactness: centre distance limit (40 x 20 mm servo; DESIGN-BASIS R9)

backup_speed_pts_s60.note: DS3235 0.13 s/60 at 5 V, 0.11 at 7.4 V (actuators.csv A19)

backup_stall_pts_kgcm.note: DS3235 datasheet 32 kg*cm at 6 V, 35 at 7.4 V (actuators.csv A19)

dA_ip_b6_mm.note: in-plane axis tilt: T16-bushed MC 99.73 % band of the across-face centre-distance change at b = 6 (analysis/gripper/tolstack/results/T16-bushed.md); every term scales with b (b/10 hole terms, c*b/L cocking)

dA_op_b6_mm.note: out-of-plane axis tilt at b = 6: the same hole-position (line-reamed +-0.03) and bore-clearance terms act isotropically, so equal to the in-plane value

da_print_mm.note: centre-distance scatter, printed housing, bushed (tolerance_stacks.md T06 window)

jt_print_mm.note: design backlash jt0 (tolerance_stacks.md T07; Sovol 0.2-0.4 for FDM gears)

k_finger_max_N_mm.note: params.json grip.k_tip_max (stiffest finger gives the hardest snag)

k_rigid_Nm_rad.note: servo gear train + horn + knuckle torsional stiffness if a knuckle hits a rigid stop

k_theta_root.note: VDI 2736 default root-temperature coefficient for POM/PA (Pogacnik & Tavcar, gears.md 5)

margin_rec.note: recommendation rule: every SF >= 1.5 x its required value (covers unmeasured print knockdowns, F_beta_y, KHb)

mu_mesh.note: dry polymer pair, 0.25-0.45 back-calculated from VDI temperatures (gears.md 4)

n_LC3.note: stall events over life (R20 back-off <= 0.2 s each)

n_shock.note: unplanned snags at full closing speed over life

rack_20.note: ISO 53 basic rack profile A (haP 1, cP 0.25 m, rhofP 0.38 m)

rack_25.note: 25 deg rack, hfP 1.25 m, near-full-round tip 0.30 m (full round is 0.318 m)

rail_V.note: brief: DS3218MG on a 6.8 V rail; torque_and_actuator.md now uses a 6.5 +-0.15 V rail (LC3 at 6.65 V: 2.09 / 3.28 N*m), so 6.8 V is ~1 % conservative

restep_per_grip.note: FSR re-steps of one deadband (0.27 deg) at full hold load per grip (DESIGN-BASIS section 8)

rim_below_root_mm.note: rim under the teeth for the sector-mass comparison

sa_min_m.note: minimum tip land, fraction of module

sa_min_print_mm.note: FDM: tip land >= ~1 extrusion width at a 0.4 mm nozzle

servo_ratio.note: DS3218MG gear ratio not published; DS3235 is 373 [S actuators.csv A19]

speed_s60_6p8V.note: DS3218MG 0.14 s/60 deg at 6.8 V (actuators.csv A17)

stall_kgcm_6p8V.note: DS3218MG 21.5 kg*cm at 6.8 V, both datasheets (actuators.csv A17)

tension_N.note: params.json grip (LC4 process tension, adds T*x_f to the servo, torque_and_actuator.md 2.3)

theta_hold_deg.note: DESIGN-BASIS section 3: contact at -0.3 deg (0.3 mm ply) plus 4.4 deg squeeze; squeeze scales 1/k over params k_tip 0.88-1.63

theta_squeeze_deg.note: DESIGN-BASIS section 3: 5 N at k = 1.0 N/mm, r_c 65

unloaded_frac.note: mesh load while closing/opening in free air, fraction of hold

load_cases.note: mesh torque, N*m; LC1/LC2 per option from x_f; values below at the printed recommendation

Al6061.kw_tag: A: Archard K 1e-5 greased / 1e-3 dry (galling) over H ~ 1 GPa
Al6061.sn_tag: S 97 MPa at 5e8 R.R. Moore (gears.md 2.2); 0.9 Su at 1e3 [A]; Goodman to R = 0

Brass.sn_tag: S C36000 H02: rho 8.2, E 100 GPa, nu 0.31, UTS 360, yield 140 MPa (makeitfrom.com); fatigue 0.35 Su at 1e8 [A]; Goodman to R = 0

PA6-CF.kw_tag: D: back-calculated from Onyx flank wear 0.186 mm after 4.86e6 cycles at 1.1 N*m vs steel, x2 self-mated [A]; l_Fl = contact-path length [A], 2.75x the involute-arc value
PA6-CF.sn_tag: D from S: gear-level fit to Hribersek 2024 printed Onyx m1 z20 b6 (1.1 N*m 6.27e6 sd 1.36e6; 1.3 N*m 2.05e6 sd 0.53e6), 90 % survival

PETG.kw_tag: S weak: printed PETG pin-on-disc 1e-4 wet / 5e-4 dry (gears.md 4)
PETG.sn_tag: A: 30.6 MPa at 1e5 (0.60 x UTS, PLA ratio, DESIGN-BASIS 4), PLA Basquin slope

PLA.kw_tag: S weak: printed PETG pin-on-disc 1e-4 wet / 5e-4 dry (gears.md 4); PLA assumed equal [A]
PLA.sn_tag: S Basquin sigma_a = 68.159 N^-0.161, R 0.05 smooth YZ coupons (gears.md 2.1) -> sigma_max = 2 sigma_a/(1-R)

POM.kw_tag: A: POM/POM greased taken as the POM/steel dry value 3.4e-6 [S VDI 2736 via Muratovic 2024] (no greased POM/POM k_w found; grease assumed to offset self-mating); POM/POM dry x3 [A] (POM/POM wore most, Pogacnik)
POM.sn_tag: D from S: gear-level lower bound = PA6 root-fatigue lives in the POM/PA6 m1 z20 b6 tests (0.42 N*m 5.4e6, 0.59 N*m 1.6e6, 0.82 N*m 0.30e6, 90 % survival); POM outlived PA6 in that pairing

profile.meta: 1:1 sector pair, m 1.5 z 19 alpha 25 x 0.0 b 8 a_w 28.500 jt 0.25 rack hfP 1.25m rhofP 0.3m; A pivot (-a/2,0) space on +X, B pivot (+a/2,0) tooth on -X

phasing.rule: offset along the line of action = rb * (theta_hold - theta_pitch) in rad; re-phase by rotating both sectors' tooth pattern by (theta_hold_new - theta_hold) about their pivots

CNC: $60-200 per pair from an online CNC service at qty 2 (small-part minimums dominate); 2D laser/waterjet from plate $15-40 but +-0.1 mm
printed: $0.05-0.20 filament per pair (<= 3 g); PA6-CF needs a hardened nozzle (~$20 once)
